values.value: Finds: Contract records born from an amendment (SBQQ__AmendedContract__c populated) where the child EndDate does not match the parent EndDate — non-coterm amendments that produce orphan contracts. Why it matters: When an amendment doesn't co-term with the parent contract, you end up with two contracts on the same account with different renewal dates. At parent renewal, the orphan is still mid-term — if the parent renews at a lower value and the orphan isn't touched, retention reporting shows apparent churn that isn't real. Distorts ATR / GRR / NRR. Suppress a finding: when the non-coterm date was intentional (customer requested staggered renewals, regulatory term limit, etc.). Disable the detector: only if your business model deliberately keeps amendment terms independent of the parent. Most CPQ implementations should co-term by default.
